text.title: Коротко
lines: Artillery is the first Gunboat weapon available, unlocked at Headquarters level 1.
Artillery fires a single projectile at the target point, damaging all Troops/Buildings and setting off all Mines, Boom Mines, and Shock Mines on hit.
Each shot costs 2 more Gunboat Energy than the previous, with a starting cost of 3 Gunboat Energy.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Use Artillery to destroy key Defensive Buildings so that your troops do not come under fire from them.
Artillery can trigger mines, neutralizing them before they threaten your troops. However, the Barrage is more effective for widely dispersed mines due to its large area of effect.
Artillery shells deal splash damage. As demonstrated in the image below, up to four buildings can be damaged with the same artillery shell.

It is possible to destroy resource and supportive buildings to accumulate more energy for other Gunboat Weaponry, but it is wise to ensure you receive more than spend on firing Artillery. Even then, Critters are more effective versus non-defensive buildings.

Artillery can be used to "mark" targets for smokey Zooka attacks on defenses in Operations. Provided that no other targets in range are more severely damaged than the marked target, the Zookas will act to attack the marked target(s) first if a Flare is not used. A similar strategy can be used to target particular buildings when using the Universal Remote.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Do not place buildings adjacent to each other, not even adjacent at a corner, as they can all be damaged or destroyed at the same time.

Upgrade defenses that are common Artillery targets to increase their health. If a defense has a lot of health, an attacker will have to use more energy to destroy it. Building Health Statues can also be used for this reason.
A Sky Shield can block a large amount of damage from Artillery.
The Umbrella Shield gadget can greatly reduce the amount of damage taken from Artillery.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: There are no visual differences between upgrades. However, damage increases (by 8-11%) with each level.

text.title: Интересное
lines: The Artillery is featured as a character skin for the King's Tower in Clash Royale.

Artillery's icon and projectile began as a simple, large cylindrical shell topped by a red dome, structured similarly to many others in the 20th century and beyond. It was eventually replaced with the current one at an unspecified date.
The Artillery appears in the Boom Beach logo as well as the Boom Pass logo, and is used as the Icon for the mission points in the Boom Pass.

text.title: Коротко
lines: The Flare is the 2nd Gunboat weaponry unlocked, at Headquarters level 3.

When a Flare is deployed and lands, all affected troops will move to its location, or attack a building tagged by it. Once they accomplish their objective or if the Flare expires, the troops will resume their usual rules of engagement.
Only one Flare can be active at a time, and the most recently deployed one takes priority above the rest.
Flares do not function during retreats.
Medics, Protectors, Dr. Kavan, Critters, Seekers, Crystal Critters, Dr. Vitamins, clones spawned by Clone Riflemen and defenses under influence of Remote Hack/Universal Remote will not follow Flares.
Each use costs 1 more Gunboat Energy than the previous, with a starting cost of 2 Gunboat Energy.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Flares can be used to flank Players who place their Headquarters at the back of their island with very little protection. By using Flares, you can guide your troops to walk around the perimeter of the island to ignore the bulk of the Defensive Buildings and into the weak spot at the back with the Headquarters. They are particularly useful for specific Smokey Warrior/Zooka/Bullit strategies.

You can guide troops into the blind spots of Mortars, Rocket Launchers, and Critter Launchers by firing a Flare right next to them. However, as troops can't fire on the move in general, they will be forced to absorb fire until they get to the target point.

Flares can be great when used with Scorchers/Incinerators and MegaScorchers, as it will force them to regroup temporarily. It's best to fire them on enemy structures so other troops won't wander into the line of fire.
Be careful when guiding mass infantry into a cluster, as the splash damage from Mortars and Rocket Launchers can potentially annihilate a large number of your troops.
Flares can be used on high-priority targets to neutralize them quickly, especially when combined with Shock Bombs.

Certain units' inability to follow Flares can be a merit, as they can attack in one direction while others strike elsewhere. This is particularly relevant for Seekers, as Flares can reposition other troops to clear the way on Warships.

Occasionally a Tribe that increases Flare duration by up to 50% appears, which is mostly useful in big Operation maps or if you need to travel the entire player base from the coast to a corner with a single usage.

In Warships some strategies may work better if the Flare is not fully upgraded, if you need your troops to split into two or more directions once it expires. This also allows to save a few Upgrade Tokens.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: There are no visual changes between levels, but each upgrade increases the Flare's duration.

text.title: Интересное
lines: The Flare was once named Signal Smoke and appeared very similar to the Smoke Screen except with colored smoke during beta. It was soon renamed and resprited with a new icon.
There is a bug where troops don't react to the flare and continue attacking their targets, so always check that all troops are actually running towards the flare.
If Scorchers are affected by this bug, they will only attack 1 building at a time.
If a troop runs towards a Flare and gets pulled by a Grappler, it will no longer react to the Flare.

With the September 2025 update, the Flare now always targets the center of a building. This change was made to buff the Sky Shield. This was changed in the November 2025 update, due to negative Feedback from the Community.
Of all the things that can be upgraded in the Armory, the Flare has the fewest upgrades, the lowest overall upgrade cost and overall upgrade time, and reaches its maximum level the fastest.
Heavies spawned upon the destruction of a Heavy Choppa and Zooka spawned upon the destruction of a Rocket Choppa used to not follow flares. This was changed after an update.

text.title: Коротко
lines: The Medkit is the 3rd weapon unlocked for the Gunboat. It is unlocked at Headquarters level 4.
When it lands, the Medkit forms a yellow ring that heals troops inside.
Medkits cannot heal troops over their original health. Once the troop has been fully healed, it will not be affected by the Medkit.
Inside the yellow ring, small green crosses appear floating in the air, indicating that troops are being healed.
The Medkit is able to stack with other Medkits as well as healing from the Medic.
The amount that the Medkit heals is applied to each individual troop within the Medkit's area of effect. The healing is not distributed between troops.
Each use costs 3 more Gunboat Energy than the previous, with a starting cost of 6 Gunboat Energy.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Because Medkit's healing is modest at best, it's not as effective on the likes of Scorchers and Pvt. Bullit. Conversely, smaller units like Riflemen or Laser Rangers benefit much more, as theoretically Medkit can heal as many troops as its range allows.

If your troops are low in health and they are reasonably close together, deploy a Medkit where they are standing if they are attacking a building. If they are moving towards a building, deploy it slightly ahead of them to compensate for the travel time the Medkit takes when fired and the movement of the troops.

If you use groups of Heavies as "meat shields" while your other troops do the damage, stack two Medkits on your Heavies to increase their lifetime as damage sponges. It should be noted that this will not help much against turrets with high single-shot damage like Cannons, Boom Cannons and Doom Cannons which might kill a Heavy in one shot before the Medkit can do much. Therefore, it is best to do this against splash defenses such as Machine Guns, Flamethrowers, and Mortars.

It is a good idea to put one or two Medkits on your Warriors as they attack the Headquarters to shield them from splash damage defenses and to heal up any damage they may have incurred from Mines on the way to the Headquarters.
You can also place a Medkit on the Warriors as they wait for the Smoke Screen to dissipate so that they will be ready to withstand damage when they are revealed.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: There are no visual differences between upgrades, the number of pulses and the duration of the effect always stays the same. However, healing per pulse increases (by 1 at levels 1-11, 2 at levels 12-18, 3 at levels 19-25 & 4 at levels 26-28).

text.title: Интересное
lines: Before 20th June 2023, the Medkit's cross was colored red.
In the Boom Beach PC announcement image, the Medkit’s cross is red instead of its in-game green color.

text.title: Коротко
lines: The Shock Bomb is the 4th weapon unlocked for the Gunboat. It is unlocked at Headquarters level 7.
The Shock Bomb itself can temporarily stun any non-flying troop as well as any Defensive Buildings (except Mines, Boom Mines, and Shock Mines, which will not be set off) in its area of effect.
The durations of the Shock Bomb will not stack if multiple bombs are fired at once on the same spot.
Each use costs 5 more Gunboat Energy than the previous, with a starting cost of 7 Gunboat Energy

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Shock Bombs are best used for stopping strong defenses which depends on your troop composition.

For example, using a Shock Bomb on Boom Cannons, Sniper Towers or Cannons when your army consists of Heavies or Tanks is beneficial. Another example would be deploying Shock Bombs on Rocket Launchers or Flamethrowers when using Riflemen and Laser Rangers, which often threatens them more than anything else.
When attacking a Boss Base with a Super Mortar or MMG 9000, Shock Bombs can be used to prevent them from obliterating your troops.
While Shock Bomb durations do not stack, with good timing it is possible to chain them on threatening defenses if you have enough energy.
Using a Shock Bomb and a Flare to deal with key defenses is a good idea, because it makes sure that the shocked defense is taken out as quickly as possible so that it cannot fire upon your troops.
Try not to hit your own troops, especially if you have a high-level Shock Bomb, as they will be stunned for the duration of the Shock Bomb.

In Smokey Zooka attacks on Operations, it is sometimes beneficial to use a Shock Bomb on Pvt. Bullit (or a Scorcher) to allow your Zookas to be placed in a desirable location relative to these high health units. This is most useful when there are a large mass of defenses, especially Rocket Launchers, that cannot all be shocked conventionally without a boatload of Gunboat Energy.

Shock Bombs cannot affect flying troops. Because of this, it is safe to deploy a Shock Bomb next to Heavy Choppas that are attacking an enemy building, although it may still end up stunning the Heavies instead.
Example of determining whether two buildings can be covered by a single shock bomb

Note that the diameter of the Shock Bomb is 6.4 tiles. This means you can find out if 2 buildings can be covered with a single Shock Bomb by calculating the shortest distance between them. By using the Pythagorean theorem, if the distance squared between the buildings is less than 6.4^2 = 40.96, then you can shock the two buildings together. See the image for an example: in the upper panel, the distance squared between the two Rocket Launchers is 40, which is less than 40.96, so they can be shocked together with a single, carefully placed Shock Bomb; in the lower panel, the distance is 41 > 40.96, so it is impossible to shock them together.
Common OP configurations which can be covered by a single shock bomb (image credit: 海岛奇兵—小鱼 on Bilibili)

For three or more buildings, the situation is more complicated. See the image for configurations commonly appearing in Operations which can be covered by a single shock bomb. The red regions, lines and dots denote where the Shock Bomb should be placed. For smoky Zooka attacks, the precise placement of those shocks can be crucial.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: A Shock Bomb is significantly less effective if it only hits a single structure, so keeping key Defensive Buildings spaced well apart will reduce the threat of Shock Bombs.
It is good to know that if there are seven squares between two Buildings, both of them cannot be shocked with a single Shock Bomb.

Placing Flamethrowers and/or Shock Launchers between the border of the island and the Headquarters is a good idea, because players that attack with Warriors that Flare directly to the HQ (or Outpost) will have to risk hitting their own Warriors if they intend to disable such defenses.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: There are no visual differences between upgrades. However, the duration of the effect increases by one second each time the Shock Bomb is upgraded.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Shock Bombs are very similar to EMPs (Electromagnetic Pulses) which disrupt and cripple electronic equipment.
The Shock Launcher's munitions resemble the Shock Bomb itself. The main difference is that they inflict a small amount of damage but cannot cause friendly fire, and with a much shorter duration.
The Shock Mine's effect is also similar to both of them, as it inflicts negligible damage, stuns only attacking troops for a moderate duration.
During the Boom Beach Beta, the Shock Bomb was only able to stun one building. This effect had since been passed to the Tiny Shock.

text.title: Коротко
lines: Barrage is the 5th weapon available for the Gunboat, unlocked at at Headquarters level 10.
Barrage fires a salvo of 15 projectiles randomly in a 3-tile radius around the target point, damaging all Troops/Buildings and setting off all Mines, Boom Mines, and Shock Mines on hit.
Each use costs 6 more Gunboat Energy than the previous, with a starting cost of 10 Gunboat Energy

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Barrage has a variety of uses. It can clear numerous Mines, Boom Mines, or Shock Mines, and can also deal heavy damage to clustered buildings.

In terms of countering Mines, Barrage competes with Critters due to the latter's lower energy demands and more predictable projectile behavior, but still isn't fully outclassed if the Mines are close to buildings or if Critters are needed for another purpose.

While Artillery tends to perform better for taking out singular threats, aiming a properly centered Barrage can be another viable answer, as most of the projectiles will usually catch it, not to mention other potential targets as collateral damage. Buildings placed near the edge of the map should still be tackled by Artillery, as Barrage projectiles may land out of bounds, reducing its total damage.

This is indeed applicable to 7x7 buildings like Power Cores and Mega Cores, which will endure its full brunt of fire. Nevertheless, this is of questionable effectiveness as both tend to be backed by Ice Statues that significantly improve their health, to the point where Barrages will barely scratch them.
The first missile of a barrage is guaranteed to hit the point where the barrage was launched, which can be useful to destroy a specific cluster of mines.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: A Sky Shield can block a large amount of damage from Barrage.
The Umbrella Shield gadget can greatly reduce the amount of damage taken from Barrage.
Spacing out buildings can reduce the total amount of damage dealt by a Barrage.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: There are no visual differences between upgrades. However, damage increases (by 8-10%) with each level.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Surprisingly, individual Barrage projectiles deal less damage than Artillery, yet possess a larger splash radius, presumably to compensate for its inaccuracy.
Barrage and Rocket Launcher share their projectile models.
Despite not having an actual duration, Barrage can be affected by the Gunboat Ability Duration buff, which increases the total number of projectiles.

text.title: Коротко
lines: The Smoke Screen is the sixth weapon unlocked for the Gunboat at Headquarters level 14.
Troops that walk into the Smoke Screen cannot be attacked, but the troops inside cannot attack either.
Medics, Dr. Kavan and Crystal Critters can still heal other Troops within the Smoke Screen.
Each use costs 1 more Gunboat Energy than the previous, with a starting cost of 2 Gunboat Energy.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Smoke Screens can be used to protect Troops like Zookas that come under fire from defenses that are dangerous to them or to protect Troops as they rush to the Headquarters.
A good strategy is Warriors, Smoke Screens, and Flares.
Use Smoke Screens to protect the Warriors while directing them to the Headquarters with a Flare.
At higher levels, or for Operations, one can use Zookas with Smoke Screens. It works the same like the Warrior, but they have a much higher damage output.

If your Troops begin to ineffectively spread out during an attack (e.g. a lone Tank moves up to a Cannon), but you don't want to move all of them with a Flare, it can be useful to cover the endangered Troop(s) with Smoke Screen until your other Troops can back them up.
Having some gaps between your Smoke Screens is okay because Troops will still be covered by smoke for about half a second after they leave it.

The Smoke Screen is good for approaching defenses that you cannot reach easily without getting noticed by the other defenses (e.g. getting to a far away Rocket Launcher when there are two Flamethrowers in the way).
This is mostly useful in Operations when you need a certain Defense taken out.

When your Troops are moving up to a defense that is dangerous against your strategy (e.g. Tanks up to a Cannon), Smoke Screen can be substituted for other Gunboat Weaponry and be used to cover your Troops until they are close enough and ready to fire at the defense in question. Once it clears, all Troops will attack at once, quickly eliminating the target. This works especially well when using Tanks, since they have high Damage Per Shot and their shots travel to the target quick enough so that they shouldn't get hit by the defense before destroying it - this works best if the defense has a rotating turret (such as a Cannon) that is pointed so that it will have to rotate in order to fire on your Troops; this way, there is a better chance the defense is destroyed before it fires.

Note that defenses with higher rates of fire - such as Flamethrowers - may still be able to attack your Troops before they are destroyed; however, these defenses will probably be destroyed before being able to do much damage (unless it's a match-up such as Riflemen vs. a Flamethrower).

The Smoke Screen will not prevent S.I.M.O., Microwav'rs, Mines, Boom Mines or Shock Mines from functioning normally. For other defenses, projectiles fired before smoke screen deployment will still hit, and defenses can also unintentionally strike your troops if they have splash damage.
If you choose to retreat, use Smoke Screens on your Troops to prevent damage to them while they are running to the Landing Craft to minimize casualties.
If a troop is low on health and is getting hit by defense(s), place a Smoke Screen on it so that the defense(s) switch targets/stop targeting it.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: Smoke Screen has no visual differences. Each upgrade increases its duration by 1 second.

text.title: Интересное
lines: The Smoke Screen resets troops' attack cooldown; therefore, when the Smoke Screen wears off, all troops that were under it will attack in sync.
Smoke Screens have been used for years in both land and naval warfare with varying purposes.
Smoke Screen is the only Gunboat Ability that changes its appearance when used on a winter-themed island to make it more visible.

text.title: Коротко
lines: Critters are the seventh and final Gunboat Ability unlocked for the Gunboat at Headquarters level 19.
The Critters ability launches a cluster of attack drones at the target point, after which they will distract enemies while attacking independently.
Critters are not affected by Medics, Medkits, Protectors, Dr. Kavan and Flares.
However, Critters can be affected by Magma Statues, Battle Orders, Iron Will, Ice Shields/Crystal Shield Projector and Dr. Kavan's Galvanizing Presence perk (through splash).
Each use costs 5 more Gunboat Energy than the previous, with a starting cost of 8 Gunboat Energy.
Critters are considered NPC units.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Critters, if deployed while troops are also deployed, serve as a distraction to the defensive buildings, taking their fire to save your troops.
Critters can be used as an alternative to the Shock Bomb. Deploy them on a vital defense that is targeting your troops to distract it. Be sure that not too many defenses are guarding said area.

Critters cannot withstand most area defenses like Flamethrowers for long, and are best used against powerful point defenses like Boom Cannons or those that deal comparatively low damage like the Lazor Beam, as they will often take several valuable seconds to wipe out the critters which can make all the difference in an attack.
Critters can also be used to clear Mines and/or Boom Mines as an alternative to using Barrage or Artillery.
They can also be used as a substitute against a building that has low health and if the energy cost of the next Critter shot is cheaper than either Artillery or Barrage.

However, when using Smokey Warriors or Smokey Zookas, it is recommended to save the Critters to distract the defenses rather than use them to clear Mines, and use Artillery and Barrage in their place.

Be careful when attempting to distract defenses with blindspots like Grapplers, Machine Guns, Mortars, Rocket Launchers and Shock Launchers. Try to place them on a building that's outside the blindspot to ensure they serve their purpose. Conversely, defenses with blindspots may also be safe to deploy critters in if they help to distract other threatening defenses.

Do not worry about your Critters after you deploy them. You should constitute the majority of your offense with your army, as Critters are hardly useful outside of being expendable distractions. Since they are deployed as gunboat weaponry, there is no need to train them either.
Critters can trigger Hot Pots and Boom Surprises, leaving them vulnerable to stun from a Shock Bomb and fire from Artillery & Barrages.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: Do not leave your Economy and Support Buildings unprotected. Critters can be used to gain lots of free energy while remaining away from defenses.
Place area defenses like Machine Guns and Flamethrowers near others that are likely to be targeted by Critters to deter the opponent from deploying the, there.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: There are no visual differences between levels. Critters always appear as small blue robots with two gun barrels that have the appearance of eyes at the front, and four legs. They also have a searchlight on the front of their hull.
Each upgrade increases the number of Critters deployed per shot by one.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Critters wander round your home base in the same way as the wildlife and villagers once they are unlocked.
During an upgrade of a non-aquatic building, they appear to walk around the building. However, Critters do not appear on the base during battle, save for those spawned by the Critter Launcher.
Critters do not count towards casualties if they die, and will stand their ground to continue distracting enemy defenses when retreating.
Even with their searchlight, they cannot fire through Smoke Screens.
Critters did not benefit from Magma Statues until the HQ27 update.

text.title: Коротко
lines: The Gunboat begins with a set amount of energy (depends on Gunboat level and Statues).
Firing Gunboat Weaponry, using Hero Abilities and deploying certain types of troops require energy. The former two have set increments for each use, and the latter expends energy per unit deployed.
All building destroyed on the battlefield give back 3 each.
There is a scheduled time when Temporary Gunboat Abilities are available to use.
Starting at level 10, the Gunboat allows two different troop loadouts to be saved and named, with more available at levels 13, 16, 19, 21, 23 and 26 respectively for a total of eight.

text.title: Что меняется с уровнем
lines: Initially, the Gunboat is a small blue-and-white ship with a wooden deck. There is a turret at the bow and a conning tower in the middle. A small blue fin-like propeller is seen. Under the bow, an anchor can be seen.

At level 2, a rope is added connecting the top of the conning tower to the stern. The conning tower is enlarged, and the entire boat is lengthened. The rails on top of the tower turn white. The top post turns yellow. The turret gains a slight redesign.

At level 4, a turret is added to the stern. The conning tower is reinforced and further expanded. The rope connecting the conning tower to the stern is removed. The entire boat also gets wider. The top of the post turns blue-gray. A ladder is added just behind the cabin. The propeller is removed.
At level 6, the conning tower is further enlarged and heightened. The rear turret is enlarged. The boat also gets slightly larger. Ladder-like rungs are added on the back of the tower.

At level 8, the wooden deck is replaced by a metal plated deck. The conning tower is enlarged again, and an balcony is added to the back. The forward turret gains another barrel and is redesigned again. The ladder on the back is replaced with a window and a balcony.

At level 10, two dual-barrel rocket launchers are added to the back of the conning tower. The rope connecting the top of the conning tower to the stern returns. The balcony's rails become blue. The post's top gains a slight red tint.

At level 15, the conning tower is entirely covered in steel plate armor, with the windows becoming light blue. The deck is replaced with smooth metal. The sides of the boat are changed to unpainted metal armor. The rear turret gains another barrel. The rope connecting the conning tower to the stern is removed. The boat also gets slightly larger. The post becomes gray. The window and balcony are removed. Also, the anchor is slightly enlarged.

At level 17, a secondary tower is added between the rocket launchers, which are replaced by blue, rectangular, six-barrel launchers resembling level 6 Rocket Launchers. A rope connects the two towers.

At level 18, a radar dish, similar to the level 9 and above Radar, is added to the top of the conning tower. The muzzles of the rocket launchers are painted yellow. The top of the posts on both towers become bright red.
At level 21, the Gunboat gains a new dark blue hull as well as a revamped exterior appearance, and its turrets and rocket launchers become larger and gray. The rope is removed.
At level 22, the barrels of the turrets are fused into a single large one. Yellow markings appear on the turrets.

text.title: Вооружение
lines: There are seven different types of weaponry that your Gunboat can fire.
Find more information about each type of weaponry in the Gunboat Weaponry pages.

text.title: Интересное
lines: It takes anywhere from less than a second to three seconds for the various weaponry to reach their designated location depending on how far the Gunboat is from the target.

Barring any Tribe boosts, the maximum possible amount of energy a player can have at the start of an attack is 344. They would have to have a level 28 Gunboat, the best Gunboat Energy Masterpiece, and 12 Guardians boosted with Power Powder.
Under the same conditions except without any boosted statues, the maximum possible energy is 201.
With Gunboat Tribe Boost the maximum becomes 373 energy with boosted statues, and 230 with unboosted statues.
At Gunboat levels 1-3, you can see the word "REEF" on its stern, which may be the Gunboat's name.
Until October 2025, Proto Troops were not saved in Troop Loadouts. Their spaces remained empty.
